metadata.methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.tec g.USBamp and g.GAMMAcap (16 active Ag/AgCl wet electrodes, 256 Hz, earlobe reference, Fpz ground). Each participant first completed a personalization stage of 12 stimuli at 10 Hz (5 s on, 5 s baseline, pairwise comfort ratings). Each then played an online 4-target SSVEP game twice, once with a personal stimulus and once with a standard stimulus, using targets at 6.25, 10, 11.11 and 14.28 Hz. Stimuli were presented with Unity3D and BCI-Essentials, and fbCCA was used for classification.
